$comment: Single source of truth for DC Hub directory listing copy (Glama, LobeHub, PulseMCP, mcpservers.org, MCP Hive, mcp.so, ...). Edit here; test/listing-copy.test.mjs enforces the copy rules, the 400-char Glama cap, the 160-char tight cap, the tool count and that `long` equals scripts/smithery_description.txt. tagline is the owner-approved tagline (2026-09-29), exact wording, no superlative. capacity_blurb is the Capacity Source paste line (count-free, price-free). tight is the variant for directories capped near 280 chars (cursor_directory): at most 160 so the backend Capacity Source line still fits beside it. tool_count and the N MCP tools phrases are healed by scripts/sync-tools-manifest.mjs. glama_live and mcpmarket_live mirror the text live on those listings (owner 2026-10-29) so drift checks compare against what is actually posted.
tagline: Live data center, power, grid, fiber and deal data for AI agents and site selection.
short: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection and the power, grid and energy infrastructure behind it. Its DCPI is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets.
long: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection and the power, grid and energy infrastructure behind it. Its DCPI is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Agents can query it and cite it. It also covers 330,000+ mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets and ISO interconnection queue snapshots, and carries live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), plus retail and wholesale electricity prices by state and ISO. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. The server has 94 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1. The free tier needs no key; paid plans: dchub.cloud/pricing. Capacity Source adds a free capacity marketplace: operators list data-center capacity at https://dchub.cloud/listings, and agents search it by size and location with source_capacity, then request an introduction with request_capacity_intro.
glama_400: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center siting that agents can query and cite. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) scores where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets daily. Also 330,000+ mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets. 94 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1. Free tier needs no key; paid plans: dchub.cloud/pricing.
tight: DC Hub is live data for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) scores grid power in 300+ markets daily. MCP: https://dchub.cloud/mcp
endpoints: 94 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1
capacity_blurb: Capacity Source by DC Hub: operators and brokers list available data-center capacity free; buyers and AI agents source it by size (kW or MW) and location with the source_capacity MCP tool or at https://dchub.cloud/listings. Contacts are shared only if the provider accepts.
glama_live: Start with execute_plan. Live, dated data for data center, colocation, power grid, site selection, interconnection and energy questions. Rank data center and datacenter markets, check interconnection queues and grid headroom across PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO and ISO-NE, pull electricity and natural gas prices, and review fiber. Cited answers. Connect: https://dchub.cloud/mcp
mcpmarket_live: Start with execute_plan: it picks and chains the right tools and returns one dated, cited answer. DC Hub: Data Center, Power Grid & Energy Intelligence. DC Hub gives AI agents live, dated data on data centers and the power behind them. Rank markets for a data center or datacenter campus, screen sites, check the interconnection queue and grid headroom across PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO and ISO-NE, pull electricity and natural gas prices, review fiber and latency, and search colocation and powered-land capacity. The Data Center Power Index (DCPI) scores markets daily. Every answer carries an as-of date and a citation line. Previews need no key. Topics: data center, datacenter, colocation, site selection, power grid, interconnection queue, electricity, natural gas, energy, fiber, power availability, DCPI, ERCOT, PJM.
